svg.title: the N-terminal domain – the ZP domain
svg.desc: Predicted model: mean pLDDT 66 of the residues around the boxes, mean pLDDT 63 of the boxes, contact PAE 3.0–13.0 Å. The boxes stand where their residues lie on the plane through them: 100 % of neighbour relations kept, distances off by 0 %.

g.text: Residue of the N-terminal domain, numbered as in the structure file
5 Å between the centres of two boxes
Predicted aligned error (PAE) of a contact in Å: written from 5 Å, bold from 10 Å. Not pLDDT
Stroke weight and opacity follow the model's pLDDT: a contact is drawn at the lower of its two ends'
values, a residue at its own. ? marks pLDDT below 50.
An interface has no centre. The residues of the N-terminal domain that touch the ZP domain come in
2 stretches of its chain: each box stands where its residue's centre lies on the plane through those
centres, at one scale, seen from the side of the ZP domain; a line joins neighbours in the chain, a
dotted line two with up to three residues between them. Those of the ZP domain are not drawn where
they lie but beside the boxes they touch. A line to one of them is a pair of residues, at the shortest of
Measured on the boxes as drawn: 2 pairs of boxes are neighbours (centres within 8 Å) in the figure or
in space; none is a neighbour in the one and more than 10 Å apart in the other: 100 % of neighbour
relations are kept. Distances between the centres of boxes differ from those in space by 0 % (root
mean square). The residues' centres lie 0.3 Å (root mean square) off the plane.
All 4 residues of the N-terminal domain at the interface are shown, with 7 contacts.
PAE (predicted aligned error) is the model's expected error, in ångström, in placing one residue of a
contact relative to the other: low is confident, about 32 means no idea. It is not pLDDT, which line
5 of the 6 residue pairs in contact have a PAE of 5 Å or more, written on their lines.
